privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: This Privacy Policy explains what personal data HAPPYEXPRESS ECOMMERCE PRIVATE LIMITED collects through Orixs and askOrixs.ai, why we collect it, how we protect it, and the rights and choices you have.

sections.title: Who We Are And Our Role
paragraphs: Orixs and askOrixs.ai are operated by HAPPYEXPRESS ECOMMERCE PRIVATE LIMITED ("Orixs", "we", "our" or "us"). Orixs provides business operating software and AI copilot features for teams, covering areas such as customer management, work management, finance, people and HR, marketplace operations, support, email and calendar.
We act as a data controller (or equivalent) for personal data about visitors to our websites, people who create an account or contact us, and our own business relationships.

When a company uses Orixs to run its business, that company is the controller of the data it puts into its workspace ("Customer Data", for example its clients, employees, orders and records) and we act as its processor (or service provider) and handle that data on its documented instructions. If your data sits in a company's workspace, please contact that company first about your rights.

sections.title: Scope Of This Policy
paragraphs: This policy applies to orixs.io, askOrixs.ai, our web and SaaS applications, our AI copilot, our support channels, and the integrations you choose to connect, including Google Sign-In, Gmail and Google Calendar. It does not apply to third-party sites or services that we link to.

sections.title: Information We Collect
paragraphs: We collect information in three ways: you give it to us, we create it while you use the platform, and we receive it from integrations you connect.
items: Account and profile data: name, email address, phone number, job title, company name, profile image, language and login credentials.

Workspace and business data you enter or upload: contacts, clients, proposals, projects, tasks, timesheets, invoices, expenses, orders, inventory, attendance, leave, payroll-related and recruitment records, tickets, notices, files, messages and calendar events.
Billing data: plan, invoices and payment status. Card and bank details are handled by our payment providers and are not stored by us in full.
Usage and device data: log data, IP address, browser and device type, pages and features used, timestamps and error reports.
Cookies and similar technologies, as described below.
Communications: messages to our support or sales teams, demo and signup requests, survey answers and feedback.
AI copilot data: the prompts you enter, the workspace context needed to answer them, and the responses and actions produced.

sections.title: Google User Data
paragraphs: Google Sign-In. If you sign in with Google, we receive your Google account identifier, name, email address, profile image and the authentication tokens needed to sign you in securely. We use them only to authenticate you, prevent unauthorized access and link your Orixs workspace to the right profile. We never receive your Google password.

Gmail and Google Calendar. If you separately connect these integrations, Orixs accesses only the Google data needed for the features you enable. Gmail data may include message metadata, content, labels, threads, attachments, drafts and sent messages, so that we can show, search, summarize, draft, send or sync mailbox activity. Calendar data may include calendar lists, event titles, attendees, dates, times, locations and descriptions, so that we can show, create, update or sync events.
These integrations are optional. You or your workspace administrator can disconnect them at any time inside Orixs, or revoke Orixs' access from your Google Account permissions page.

sections.title: Google API Limited Use Disclosure
paragraphs: Orixs' use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

We use Google user data only to provide or improve user-facing features that you request or enable, such as Google Sign-In, mailbox and calendar sync, email drafting or sending, workspace search, summaries and copilot actions. We do not sell Google user data. We do not use it for advertising, including retargeting or interest-based ads. We do not use Google Workspace API data to develop, improve or train generalized AI or machine learning models. Humans read Google user data only where you ask us to for support, where it is needed to investigate abuse or protect security, or where the law requires.

sections.title: How We Use Information And Our Legal Bases
paragraphs: We use personal data only for specified purposes and, where data protection law such as the GDPR applies, only where we have a legal basis:
items: To provide and operate the platform, create and manage accounts, run the modules you enable, sync integrations and give support. Basis: performance of our contract with you or your organization.
To secure the platform, prevent fraud and abuse, keep audit logs and troubleshoot. Basis: our legitimate interests in running a safe and reliable service.
To improve and develop the product, measure usage and plan capacity. Basis: our legitimate interests, or your consent where the law requires it.
To send service notices, billing messages and security alerts. Basis: contract and legitimate interests.
To send marketing about Orixs. Basis: your consent or, where permitted, our legitimate interests. You can opt out at any time.
To comply with legal, tax, accounting and regulatory obligations and to establish or defend legal claims. Basis: legal obligation and legitimate interests.
Where we rely on consent, you may withdraw it at any time without affecting earlier processing.

sections.title: AI Copilot Processing
paragraphs: When you use Orixs AI or askOrixs.ai, your prompt, the workspace context you allow and relevant module data are processed to answer your request or perform an action. The copilot can read, create, update or delete records only within your account permissions, your company workspace boundaries and the modules that are enabled. High-risk actions, such as sending emails, deleting records, approvals or payroll changes, require your confirmation before they run.

AI output can be incomplete or inaccurate. Please review it before relying on it, especially for legal, financial, employment or compliance decisions. We use third-party AI infrastructure providers to process these requests under confidentiality and security obligations. Google user data is never used to train generalized models, as stated above.

sections.title: Cookies And Similar Technologies
paragraphs: We use cookies and local storage that are strictly necessary to sign you in, keep your session secure, remember your language and protect against abuse. Where we use analytics or other non-essential cookies, we do so to understand how the site is used and to improve it, and, where the law requires, only with your consent. You can control or delete cookies in your browser settings; blocking essential cookies may stop parts of the service from working.

sections.title: How We Share Information
paragraphs: We do not sell personal data and we do not share it for cross-context behavioral advertising. We share it only in these cases:
items: Service providers (subprocessors) that help us run Orixs, such as cloud hosting, database and storage, email delivery, analytics, payment processing, customer support, security monitoring and AI infrastructure. They may process data only on our instructions and under confidentiality and security terms.
Integrations and actions you direct, for example when you connect a Google account or send a message through a connected channel.
Professional advisers, auditors and insurers under duties of confidentiality.
Authorities, courts or other parties where required by law or to protect rights, safety and security.
A successor in a merger, acquisition, financing or sale of assets, with notice to you where required.

sections.title: International Transfers
paragraphs: Orixs may process and store personal data in countries other than your own, including India and the countries where our providers operate. Where the law requires, we transfer data only with appropriate safeguards, such as standard contractual clauses, adequacy decisions or other lawful transfer mechanisms, and we process it in line with this policy.

sections.title: Data Retention
paragraphs: We keep personal data only for as long as needed for the purposes in this policy. In general, account and workspace data is kept while the account is active and for a limited period afterwards so you can export it or reactivate. Google OAuth tokens are kept only while the integration is connected, or as needed for security and audit. Billing and tax records are kept for the period required by law. Audit and security logs are kept for a limited period to protect the service.
When data is no longer needed, we delete it or de-identify it, subject to backups that roll off on a regular cycle and to any legal hold.

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: We use administrative, technical and organizational safeguards designed to protect personal data against unauthorized access, loss, misuse and alteration. These include encryption in transit (HTTPS), access controls, tenant-level company scoping, role-based permissions, audit logs, token protection, secure deployment practices, monitoring, and restricted access to production systems. No system is completely secure, but we work to keep our protections in line with the sensitivity of the data.

sections.title: Personal Data Breaches
paragraphs: If we become aware of a personal data breach that affects you or your organization, we will investigate and contain it, and notify affected customers and, where required, the relevant authorities and individuals without undue delay and within the time limits set by applicable law.

sections.title: Your Rights And Choices
paragraphs: Depending on where you live, you may have some or all of the following rights over your personal data. We honor them as the law requires, whichever country you are in:
items: Access and portability: know what we hold about you and receive a copy in a common format.
Correction: have inaccurate or incomplete data updated.
Deletion: ask us to erase your data, subject to legal retention duties.
Restriction and objection: limit or object to certain processing, including direct marketing.
Withdraw consent at any time where processing is based on consent.
Opt out of the sale or sharing of personal data (we do not sell or share it) and of targeted advertising.
Non-discrimination for exercising your privacy rights.
Nominate another person to exercise your rights, and use available grievance redress, where your law provides (for example under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023).
Lodge a complaint with your data protection authority.

sections.title: How To Exercise Your Rights
paragraphs: Use the settings in your account where available, or email us using the address in the Contact section. We may ask you to verify your identity before acting on a request. We respond within the time required by applicable law, generally within 30 days, and tell you if we need more time or cannot fully comply and why.

Workspace administrators control users, modules, permissions and retention settings for their organization. If your request concerns Customer Data, we will refer you to your organization or help it respond.

sections.title: Customer Data And Data Processing Terms
paragraphs: Where we process Customer Data as a processor, we do so only on the customer's documented instructions, ensure personnel are bound by confidentiality, apply appropriate security measures, use subprocessors under written terms, help the customer respond to data subject requests and security incidents, and delete or return Customer Data at the end of the services as described above. A data processing agreement is available to business customers on request.

sections.title: Children
paragraphs: Orixs is built for business users and is not directed to children. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children below the age set by applicable law. If you believe a child has given us personal data, contact us and we will delete it.

sections.title: Third-Party Links
paragraphs: Our service may link to or integrate with third-party websites and services. Their privacy practices are their own and we are not responsible for them. Please read their policies before using them.

sections.title: Changes To This Policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top shows when it was last changed. If we make material changes, we will notify you through the website, the application or by email. If a change affects how we use Google user data, we will ask for any consent that is required before using the data for a new purpose.

You are responsible for reviewing AI output and the actions you approve before relying on them, and for decisions you make using them. Actions run within your permissions, and high-risk actions need your confirmation. Our Privacy Policy explains how data is processed for AI features, including our commitments for Google user data.
